newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list municipal market chain.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list municipal market chain.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange (ISE) said it would list shares of municipal market chain Tansas Izmir Buyuksehir Belediyesi Ic ve Dis Ticaret A.S. on the national market on Monday.
The opening price will be 9,500 lira per 1,000 nominal-valued share.
Tansas had offered 82.45 billion lira of its 250 billion lira share capital to the public in a two-day offer last week.

Offer manager Global Securities said 75.2 percent of the total offer was sold to 31 foreign institutional investors, 19.4 percent to 11,670 domestic individual investors and 5.4 percent to domestic investment trusts.
Moore Capital Management Emerging Markets bought 8.31 percent of the total offer, Genesis Smaller Companies Fund acquired 6.97 percent and GE Investment got 5.46 percent, Global said.

Tansas whose headquarters are based in the Aegean port city of Izmir, operates 90 supermarkets in Turkey's western Aegean region. It holds about 40 percent market share in Izmir and is one of the two biggest supermarket chains in Turkey.
Izmir Municipality is the major shareholder of Tansas with a 61.29 percent capital stake after the offer.
The Exchange said Izmir municipality would not sell new shares from its own stake for 180 days without Global's written consent. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
